_readme: Caption looks for the Captions panel. 'templates' are built in and cannot be deleted from the app: edit or add entries here, restart the server and hard-refresh the browser. Every field of 'style' is optional (a missing one takes the default). Looks you save in the app live in your browser. Fonts: font ids are poppins, inter, archivo, oswald (see CAPTION_FONTS in js/shared/captions.js; to add a font, put the .ttf in server/assets/fonts and add it there). Colours are #rrggbb. size = % of the frame width; stroke and shadow = fraction of the text size; y = where the caption sits, % of the frame height from the top; widthPct = widest a line may be, % of the frame width. highlight: none | color | pop (the spoken word changes colour, pop also swells). animIn: none | fade | pop | slide | bounce. animOut: none | fade. reveal: page (all words at once) | word (words appear as they are spoken).

templates.label: Pop Highlight
templates.description: Bold uppercase words, the spoken word turns yellow and swells.

templates.label: Big Impact
templates.description: Huge heavy words, one or two at a time, with a bounce.

templates.label: Karaoke
templates.description: A full line; each word lights up cyan as it is spoken.

templates.label: Clean Box
templates.description: White text on a soft black box, easy to read on any picture.

templates.label: Neon Edge
templates.description: Cyan letters with a hot-pink edge.

templates.label: Typewriter
templates.description: Words appear one by one in the middle of the picture.

templates.label: Slide-Up Minimal
templates.description: Small, calm lines that slide up near the bottom.

templates.label: Condensed Headline
templates.description: Tall condensed capitals with a gold spoken word.
